title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — September 30, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C8.6 (Peaked September 30, 2026 at 02:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 298 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Working hard or hardly fusing? ✨☀️

A broad dark coronal feature and several small active regions are visible, while the outer corona looks otherwise routine.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
